newsitem.title: UK: ILZSG seeks better definition of waste materials.
newsitem.headline: ILZSG seeks better definition of waste materials.

text.p: The International lead and Zinc study Group (ILZSG) is to call for a clearer distinction between waste and secondary raw materials.

In a release following its spring meeting the ILZSG said it would make several recommendations to the Basel Secretariat, the OECD and the European Union, having undertaken a study of the implications of the Basel Convention on lead and zinc.
It said that the OECD should hasten its development of a distinction between what is waste (for disposal) and secondary raw materials (for recycling).
Among other recommendations the ILZSG is seeking closer co-ordination on legislation and an examination of the problems of environmental protectionism.
